name: DSIP
effects: Neuropeptide originally isolated from rabbit thalamus — induces delta (slow-wave) sleep in animals
Modulates stress response via CRH and LH axis; antistress and anxiolytic properties in rodent studies
Inconsistent replication across human studies; evidence base weak compared to other sleep aids
Reported effects: faster sleep onset, increased SWS, reduced cortisol reactivity
Explored for opioid/alcohol withdrawal support — preliminary data only
Short plasma half-life due to rapid peptide degradation
No FDA approval; limited human safety data
Sourced from research-chemical suppliers — purity and sterility not guaranteed; risk of contamination
